item.title: Austin Police updates policies related to ICE warrants, cooperation
item.description: Austin Police Department released new orders for how officers handle administrative warrants and detainer requests issued by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement, in a Wednesday memo from APD Chief Lisa Davis to the Austin City Council.

item.title: Paxton 'would consider dropping out' of runoff if Senate eliminates filibuster and passes SAVE Act
item.description: President Donald Trump has asked whichever candidate he doesn't support to withdraw from the Republican nominee race for U.S. Senate, but Paxton has preemptively refused. Instead, he's offered to drop out if Senate Leadership agrees to pass the Save America Act, which is unlikely to happen.

item.title: Texas softball’s power surge hits SEC play after 17 straight wins
item.description: No. 3 Texas softball enters SEC play on a 17-game winning streak, powered by home-run leaders Katie Stewart and Reese Atwood. The Longhorns open a ranked road series at No. 24 South Carolina this weekend.

item.title: Levels at Lake Travis, Lake Buchanan could change this spring
item.description: New lake level projections released for Lake Travis and Lake Buchanan, two main water reservoirs serving Central Texas, show how different scenarios could impact their storage.

item.title: Texas to play Alabama in SEC women's quarterfinals after Tide rolls Lady Vols
item.description: The 11th-seeded Crimson Tide beat the sixth-seeded Lady Volunteers 76-64 to secure their second win of the tournament after defeating 14th-seeded Missouri 65-48 on Wednesday. Jessica Timmons led the way for Alabama with 23 points, and Ta'Mia Scott poured in 20.

item.title: Austin police release body-cam footage, 911 calls from Sixth Street mass shooting
item.description: Austin Police released new information and video about the deadly mass shooting at a bar on West Sixth Street during a news conference Thursday.

item.title: Rain and severe storm chances ramp up this weekend
item.description: Rain chances return tomorrow and continue through the week, with multiple chances for severe weather --Nick Bannin

item.title: Buford's Backyard Beer Garden announces reopen date, donation of weekend proceeds to victims' families
item.description: Buford's Backyard Beer Garden reopens March 6 after the tragic shooting that injured 18 people. To honor the victims, Buford's plans to donate 100% of there sales from their opening weekend to families and those most affected.

item.title: DPS academy recruit accused of sexually assaulting UT student, affidavit says
item.description: A Texas Department of Public Safety academy recruit is accused of sexually assaulting a University of Texas student after the two met at a downtown Austin bar, according to court records.

item.title: Judge halts renovations at Camp Mystic Guadalupe site as flood victim's family fights to prevent reopening
item.description: A judge blocked Camp Mystic from renovating or altering its Guadalupe site at the request of the family of one of the young victims of the devastating Independence Day floods.
